facts.text: The Broncho Advantage waiver pays up to $2,000 per regular semester and $1,000 per summer semester toward nonresident charges for students from eight neighboring states.

sources.title: Broncho Advantage - UCO
sources.quote: The Broncho Advantage is a tuition waiver that can pay up to $2,000 per fall/spring semester and up to $1,000 per summer semester toward nonresident tuition charges for four years.
